remarks: You can be the first to live in this nicely updated, top floor 2-bedroom end unit at Sheffield Ridge! Features a beautiful kitchen with granite counters and stainless steel appliances, and a bright, spacious living room with dining area. Recently painted, newer carpeting throughout and ample closet space. This elevator building includes off-street parking in gated lot for 2 cars plus street parking and laundry on-site. Heat, hot water and cooking gas included in monthly HOA. Located near Norwalk Hospital, prominent restaurants, shopping, major highways and train station. Don't miss this wonderful opportunity- schedule an appointment to preview.
